title: ConformanceRecord
description: Per-op SLA-conformance measurement emitted by the qsub-01 latency benchmark harness. This is the qsub-01<->qsub-03 contract surface (schema-shape seam) mirroring coordinator_core/benchmarks/record.py:ConformanceRecord. floor_scope='run' means cold_start_floor_ms/floor_cov are measured once per harness run and shared by every record sharing the same run_id -- do not interpret cross-op floor_delta_ms as paired per-op measurements.

op.description: Op name, e.g. 'ping' or 'coverage.gate' -- matches OP_CLASSIFICATION keys.

target_ms.description: Resolved end-to-end budget target in milliseconds.

tolerance.description: Gate tolerance band descriptor applied to target_ms.

gating_statistic.description: Name of the statistic the verdict was computed against (pinned to 'min'). Review: code-reviewer (Slice A F2, P2) -- enforced at the contract boundary, matching schema_version's const discipline; loosen only alongside a coordinated multi-statistic wave.

gating_statistic_value.description: Actual numeric value of gating_statistic for this op/run.

sample_count.description: N -- number of valid (exit-0, non-error) timed samples collected.

cold_start_floor_ms.description: Run-level ping-derived cold-start floor statistic. A measured baseline, distinct from floor_delta_ms (the op-relative offset).

floor_delta_ms.description: Signed, nullable: op statistic minus cold_start_floor_ms. Advisory-only -- never a gating quantity.

floor_cov.description: Coefficient of variation of the floor-stability pass for this run.

floor_scope.description: Measurement granularity convention for cold_start_floor_ms/floor_cov. Wave-1 only ever emits 'run'.

run_id.description: Identifier shared by every record emitted from the same harness run (same floor draw). Distinct from baseline_id.

baseline_id.description: Identifier of the baseline-store entry this record was persisted as. Distinct from code_sha (the git commit alone).

code_sha.description: Full git commit SHA the harness measured against, captured once at harness.run entry.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this record was produced.

runner_isolation_mode.description: Execution environment isolation descriptor for this run.

machine.description: Machine identity this record was measured on (platform.system() + platform.node(), lowercased, joined). Null on a migrated v1 record, which names no machine and is never a comparable baseline.

ambient_before.description: Ambient-load snapshot (ambient_sampler.take_sample() shape) taken in-process at run start. Every inner field is independently nullable.

ambient_after.description: Ambient-load snapshot (same shape as ambient_before) taken in-process at run end, outside the timed measurement window.

ambient_delta.description: Per-field (ambient_after - ambient_before) numeric delta. Null if either snapshot is null; an individual field within it degrades to null if either side is null.

schema_version.description: Pinned contract version for this record shape.
